New chain: ETH (Ethereum) — implied by etherscan link. Hmm, but which is "the" old contract? Ambiguous. Maybe report BSC one? The coin H on CMC — Humanity Protocol is on BSC? Actually H token... The migration is from both chains to ETH. I'll report the ETH old contract since same chain. Alternatively include both? Field is single value. I'll go with ETH old.

Ratio 1, evidence "1:1 swap". Event type: token_swap (contract swap across chains — chain_migration? It's a swap from BSC and ETH to new ETH contract; "token_swap" fits since notice says swap). The typical CMC notice "undergone a 1:1 swap from the old contract ... to new contract" is a contract swap. I'll pick contract_swap.

New chain: Ethereum, evidence "https://etherscan.io/token/0xE76c5b78f93909d34404E9eb4C1f19e7582a5dE1" — etherscan implies Ethereum but not stated textually. Rule: never guess chain.
